newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power Corp says nuke again shut.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power Corp says nuke again shut.

text.p: Florida Power Corp confirmed Tuesday its 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River 3 nuclear power plant had tripped off line late Monday, shortly after bringing the unit back from an outage last week.
The company said there was no restart date yet for the unit, located in Red Level, Fla.

"Crystal River 3 came off line at 2100 EDT Monday," said company spokeswoman Karen Raihill, adding the utility decided to shut the plant after discovering a problem with its "main oil bearing pressure."
"We have not establish a restart time," she said.
Crystal River 3 was running at reduced capacity last week for repairs and maintenance, and was expected to resume full output this past weekend.
